notes.subject: jɔyɔrɔ sena
notes.rationale: Hebrew says only 'head'; Bamanankan needs the chief-sense made explicit.

notes.subject: אבחר דרכם
notes.rationale: 'I chose their way' vs 'I chose to go their way' — whether Job selects their path for them or follows them.

notes.subject: ינחם
notes.rationale: נחם means both 'comfort' and 'regret'; here comfort of mourners, but the sigh-root carries both senses.

notes.subject: בגדוד
notes.rationale: 'in the army/troop' could be 'among the troops' or 'when troops surround' as a besieged king.

translation: Ne ye u siraw sugandi, ne jɔra ⟨jɔyɔrɔ sena⟩ kun tigi ye, ani ne degunna i n'a fɔ masakɛ ye jen kɔnɔ, i n'a fɔ mɔgɔ min bɛ sosokɔrɔbaganw bɔ yo.
